faqs.question: What retinal, cataract, and general eye services does Palamu Neuro & Eye Care offer for Palamu patients?
faqs.answer: Palamu Neuro & Eye Care provides a full spectrum of eye care services for Palamu patients, encompassing both routine and advanced subspecialty care. Retinal services include diabetic retinopathy screening with laser photocoagulation, intravitreal anti-VEGF injections for macular degeneration and diabetic macular edema, retinal detachment evaluation and surgical repair, and macular hole surgery. Cataract services cover comprehensive pre-operative evaluation and modern cataract surgery. The clinic also offers glaucoma diagnosis and management, comprehensive eye examinations, OCT, OCT-A, fundus photography, and visual field testing — all under the expert supervision of Dr. Dibya Prabha.
